title: field_ops.sla.breach v1
description: Emitted when a field order crosses its SLA target (elapsed_minutes >= target_minutes) and a SlaBreachLog row is inserted. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex EventPublisher (workers/event_publisher.ex relay/1 -> build_envelope/3) from the [:alebrije_field_ops, :sla, :breached] telemetry event (slas.ex:332). FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) — fields are top-level, matching the real producer: build_envelope/3 merges the telemetry metadata (stringified) with the m_-prefixed measurements and stamps event_type. The on-the-wire event_type EN-USO is 'field_ops.sla.breach' (NOT field_ops.sla.breached): this is the name the consumers subscribe to — agentic CrossModuleEventConsumer (config.py:54) and mcp-go eventbridge sla-breach-notify trigger (defaults.go:41). Atoms and DateTimes are normalised to strings by to_envelope_value/1; numeric measurements (elapsed_minutes) and target_minutes pass through as integers.

event_type.description: Canonical event_type EN-USO stamped by build_envelope/3. Consumers route on this exact value.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the breached order. Stringified from the telemetry metadata tenant_id (ADR-25).

context_id.description: Optional multi-context selector (ADR-25). Stringified from telemetry metadata; may be null when the order has no context.

order_id.description: ID of the field_orders row that breached its SLA.

sla_id.description: ID of the Sla definition that was breached.

sla_name.description: Human-readable name of the breached SLA (sla.name).

target_minutes.description: Configured SLA target in minutes (sla.target_minutes). Passes through as an integer.

event.description: Source telemetry event label carried in the metadata. For this stream record it is 'breached'.

m_elapsed_minutes.description: Elapsed minutes from order creation to breach detection. The m_ prefix mirrors how build_envelope/3 namespaces telemetry measurements (measurements -> m_<key>).
